title: Bilinear (low-rank matrix-factorized) 2D decoder replaces flatten+PCA for fig04

claims.statement: Flattening a trial's (N x T) matrix into an N*T vector before PCA (as decode_fig04_v5/v6 do) destroys laminar/spatial topology and temporal continuity and yields uninterpretable components; a rank-K bilinear model W = sum_k u_k v_k^T is the preferred alternative.
claims.note: Entered at 'unconfirmed' per the user-is-a-source rule. Whether it also decodes BETTER on this corpus is an empirical question v7-vs-v6 answers directly.

claims.statement: jnwb/bilinear.py's alternating-logistic bilinear fit recovers a known rank-1 spatiotemporal ground truth.
claims.receipt: Synthetic rank-1 case (N=12, T=20, n=300, u supported on channels 3-5, v a Gaussian bump at bin 14): test acc 0.93 vs 0.5 chance; |u_hat| vs u corr 0.997 with top-3 indices exactly [3,4,5]; |v_hat| vs v corr 0.983 with argmax bin 15 vs truth 14; 66 params vs 482 flattened. Run 2026-08-07.
claims.caveat: Objective is biconvex, not jointly convex -- solution depends on the seeded init of V; convergence is to a local optimum.

claims.statement: LFP (low-frequency, <100Hz, per-channel scalar power) decodes the identity of a PRESENTED stimulus above chance -- storyline item (1) for the LFP modality.
claims.receipt: 2-session smoke test of scripts/decode_lfp_1d_positive_control_and_omission.py (282.8s): V1 0.762, V4 0.745, TEO 0.730, V3 0.718, PFC 0.608 (n=3-6 cells each). Full 21-session run launched 2026-08-07 (bgl0bxeo2) -- status stays 'unconfirmed' until that lands.
claims.note: 2 sessions is a smoke test, not the corpus. Do not quote these numbers as the result.

issues: v6 full-corpus run (flatten+PCA, both modalities, 5 windows) and v7 (bilinear) must be compared on identical cells; v7 imports v6's feature builders precisely so any difference is attributable to the estimator alone.
v7 applies log10 to LFP power (v6 does not). This is a second changed variable on the LFP arm -- the spikes arm isolates the estimator cleanly, the LFP arm does not.
Not yet built, and not requested: temporal cross-generalization (T x T) matrices, sliding-window time-resolved p_A(t) curves, layer-wise decoders.
falsifier: Closed when v6 and v7 have both completed the full 21-session corpus and their per-area/per-window accuracies are tabulated side by side, with the best/worst area named per modality.
